outcome: Decrease in repeated adhesion formation of the pelvis
Effectiveness of regression of the adhesive process
Effectiveness of treatment for tubal-peritoneal infertility and chronic salpingo-oophoritis
cohort: 235 women (average age 28 ± 7 years) with impaired reproductive function who underwent laparoscopic reconstructive plastic surgery on the pelvic organs due to tubal-peritoneal infertility (TPI) and chronic nonspecific salpingo-oophoritis (CNSO).
finding: The addition of magnetic infrared-laser therapy and sulfide balneotherapy to conventional treatment significantly improved clinical symptoms, reduced pelvic pain, decreased adhesion formation, and increased treatment effectiveness and fertility restoration in women with tubal-peritoneal infertility and chronic salpingo-oophoritis compared to conventional therapy alone.
